initial_usable_ms.basis: Existing A12 initial usable render target; measure supported native hardware.

screen_feedback_ms.basis: Existing A12 ordinary screen feedback target.

live_feedback_ms.basis: Existing A12 local live-control target; excludes authoritative round trip.

peak_rss_bytes.basis: Proposed 512 MiB native process ceiling; requires actual workload/hardware evidence.

package_bytes.basis: Proposed 200 MiB package ceiling excluding separately downloaded optional media; measure actual Windows installer and Android APK.

optional_media_in_core_bytes.basis: Optional heavy media must remain separate from mandatory core.

configuration_steps.basis: Proposed mandatory per-session setup ceiling after one-time account/Campaign setup.

lifecycle_interactions.basis: Proposed per-person recurring lifecycle ceiling; count actual UI interactions, not HTTP calls.

administration_minutes.basis: Proposed mandatory clerical work per person/session; exclude voluntary creative prep and play, include duplicate bookkeeping.

manual_memory_minutes.basis: Proposed mandatory duplicate campaign-memory/journal maintenance; ordinary adjudication and optional personal notes excluded.

unintegrated_external_tools.basis: Every required external dependency must have an integrated, bounded Multiversal workflow.

scope: Approves exact reviewed budget limits. Actual installed-device and representative human observations remain required. No lifecycle certification, public release or commerce authorization is inferred.
